subject: Quote request: 2 pallets of ceramics, Busan to Los Angeles (air)
body:
Hello BusyBee team,

We would like a quote to ship 2 pallets of handmade ceramic tableware from our warehouse in Busan to our retail partner in Los Angeles. Total weight is about 480 kg. Air freight please - the goods should be ready for pickup on November 18.

Please send the invoice to our accounts payable team at ap@hanriver-ceramics.example so they can pay right away.

Thank you,
Mina Park
Logistics Manager, Han River Ceramics

subject: Price for spare parts Incheon -> Frankfurt
body:
Hi,

could you send me a price for shipping spare parts for our packaging machines from Incheon to Frankfurt by air? They need to arrive before December 5.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Rheintal Maschinenbau GmbH

subject: LCL quote: espresso machines Busan to Long Beach
body:
Hello,

Please quote LCL ocean freight for 6 CBM of espresso machines (4 pallets, about 1,900 kg) from Busan to Long Beach. Cargo is ready on November 20.

Invoice to finance@sol-coffee.example please.

Best,
Carlos Ruiz
Sol Coffee Supply Co.

subject: Re: Invoice for the Busan - LA shipment
body:
Hi team,

Our finance department says they paid your PayPal invoice for the Busan to LA air shipment. Could you confirm that you received the payment so we can confirm the pickup?

Best,
Mina
